title: Dustbelcher
wikitext:
The '''Dustbelcher''' [[Ogre]]s are primitive ogres living in the [[Badlands]] where they try to maintain a living.

[[Camp Cagg]], [[Camp Kosh]], [[Camp Wurg]] and [[Camp Boff]] is the home of some of the Dustbelcher [[Ogre]]s. The Dustbelcher tribe is led by Boss Tho'grun, who wanders in between the camps.
